6.cg: Elizabeth wants what she's owed. Zach wants her back in his life -- but he hasn't come to terms with the fact that that life is not going to happen for him, not with her and not a life that she'd ever want to be part of with him.
6.act_desc: Elizabeth arrives. She's heard Zach paid a full year's rent in advance. She's still part owner until the paperwork clears — half that money is hers. She's not cruel. She's just surviving. Zach sees it. It doesn't make it less devastating.

8.cg: Hye-Jin wants to execute the job cleanly; her empathy is already engaged
8.loc: INT. TOGG'S MANSION STUDIO / EXT. WEST HOLLYWOOD HILLS — DAY. The mansion backs up to a bop house next door. Deja can hear it through the walls and wants in. Hye-Jin clocks the vibe immediately — she knows she's content in this room, knows she'll be objectified. She's made her peace with that. What she won't do is make her sexuality the product.
8.opp: Hye-Jin isn't naive — she knows she's content, knows she's being objectified as atmosphere in Togg's videos. She's accepted that. What she won't cross is the line between being scenery and making her sexuality a commercial product. In her mind those are completely different worlds: one is a ring girl, one is a porn star. She's a ring girl. And even if she couldn't see that line herself, her mother would kill her, then disown the body.
